name: Milnacipran
aliases: Savella, Midalcipran, Milnacipranum, levomilnacipran, Levomilnacipran, (1S,2R)-milnacipran, F-2695, Fetzima®
summary: Milnacipran, sold under the brand name Savella among others, is a serotonin–norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI) used in the clinical treatment of fibromyalgia, major depressive disorder, and neuropathic pain., France).
